p='src/intake.py'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old=s[s.index('# Some providers'):s.index('class Intake')]
new='''def storage_key(hook: Webhook) -> str:
    # Providers do not all resend the original event id on retry (harbor and
    # northwind mint a new one, e.g. po_1844 -> po_1844.2), but the
    # Idempotency-Key header is stable across retries. Use the full header,
    # scoped by provider so two providers' keys cannot collide, and fall back
    # to the event id only when the header is missing.
    if hook.idempotency_key:
        return f"{hook.provider}:{hook.idempotency_key}"
    return hook.event_id


'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_keys_sharing_a_prefix_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_1", "aaaabbbb-1111", amount=18_000))
    second = intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_2", "aaaabbbb-2222", amount=2_000))
    assert second.applied is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000


def test_same_key_from_different_providers_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "shared-key-0001", amount=1_000))
    second = intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_9", "shared-key-0001", amount=500))
    assert second.applied is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 1_500
EOF
